request.style: English, female soul voice, solo, acoustic guitar, upright bass, brushed drums, piano, warm and reverent, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A priest named Zechariah served the Lord
His wife Elizabeth from Aaron's line
Righteous and blameless in all their ways
Yet barren and advanced in years
No child came to fill their home
Waiting on God in silent prayer

[Chorus]
Blessed are you among women
Blessed is the fruit of your womb
The child leaped for joy inside
Filled with the Holy Spirit now
Blessed is she who believed
That what the Lord said would be true

[Verse]
The angel stood by the altar side
Saying do not be afraid Zechariah
Your prayer has been heard at last
Your wife will bear a son to you
Name him John and he will be great
Filled with the Spirit from his birth

[Chorus]
Blessed are you among women
Blessed is the fruit of your womb
The child leaped for joy inside
Filled with the Holy Spirit now
Blessed is she who believed
That what the Lord said would be true

[Bridge]
When Mary came to the hill country
The baby leaped in Elizabeth's womb
She cried out with a loud voice
Why am I favored so today
The mother of my Lord is here
Her faith made my soul rejoice

[Verse]
The time came for her to give birth
She bore a son and neighbors rejoiced
They heard of the Lord's great mercy
And they rejoiced with her that day
But when they came to name the child
Her mother spoke up with strength

[Chorus]
Blessed are you among women
Blessed is the fruit of your womb
The child leaped for joy inside
Filled with the Holy Spirit now
Blessed is she who believed
That what the Lord said would be true

[Outro]
No one among relatives had that name
But his mother insisted he be John
And everyone was amazed at last
